name: Facebook Comment Automation - Private Reply + Public Reply + Like

parameters.content:
## Facebook Comment Automation

Graph API version: **v26.0** (graph.facebook.com).

Env vars required:
- FACEBOOK_PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN (Page access token)
- FACEBOOK_PAGE_ID
- FACEBOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN

Meta app: subscribe the Page to the webhook field **feed**.
Permissions: pages_show_list, pages_manage_metadata, pages_read_engagement, pages_messaging, pages_manage_engagement.

Credentials: one **Postgres** credential. Table: **fb_processed_comments** (SQL in the README / chat).

Flow: new comment -> keyword match -> like the comment + private reply (DM with button) -> public reply.
Comments without a keyword from "Message Rules Configuration" are ignored.

Facebook allows ONE private reply per comment, within 7 days.

## Retry design

Send Private Reply / Reply to Comment use onError = "continue using error output" (success = output 0, error = output 1).
HTTP Request outputs (success and error) do NOT carry the input fields, so the nodes right after them
recover the context with $('Select Random DM').item / $('Select Random Public Reply').item (paired items).
The attempt counter uses $runIndex of the Classify node (1st run = attempt 1).

The Classify-Error nodes read the status code defensively (error.httpCode / error.statusCode / error.cause.httpCode).
**Verify this against your instance during testing.**

429 / 500 / 502 / 503 / 504 -> retry (max 3 attempts, Retry-After honoured, else exponential backoff)
400 / 401 / 403 -> permanent, no retry

If the DM succeeds but the public reply fails, the row stays dm_status=sent / public_reply_status=failed.
Use "Retry Failed Public Replies" to retry ONLY the public reply, never the DM.

nodes.name: Facebook Webhook Verify (GET)
nodes.notes: Meta calls this once when you save the webhook subscription in the App Dashboard.

nodes.name: Facebook Webhook Events (POST)
nodes.notes: Responds 200 immediately (Meta requires a fast ack) then keeps processing below.

nodes.name: Extract Comment Events
nodes.notes: Keeps only feed changes with item=comment and verb=add (new comments). Edits, deletions, reactions and posts are ignored.

nodes.name: Ignore - Invalid Event
nodes.notes: Status: comment ignored (malformed payload - missing comment_id or post_id).

nodes.name: Ignore Own Comments
nodes.notes: Skips comments posted by the Page itself (including our own public replies, which come back as new comments).

nodes.name: Ignore - Own Comment
nodes.notes: Status: comment ignored (posted by our own Facebook Page).

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO fb_processed_comments (comment_id, post_id, comment_text, username, created_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, now())
ON CONFLICT (comment_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING comment_id, post_id, comment_text, username;

nodes.name: Reserve Comment (Atomic)
nodes.notes: Atomic dedup+reservation in a single statement. If the comment_id already exists, 0 rows are returned and nothing flows downstream. RETURNING echoes back every column downstream nodes need.

nodes.name: Message Rules Configuration
nodes.notes: EDIT ME: keywords, rule priority, DM texts, button title/URL. Comments without any keyword are ignored (no DM, no public reply).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ $json.button_url ? { recipient: { comment_id: $json.comment_id }, message: { attachment: { type: 'template', payload: { template_type: 'button', text: $json.selected_dm, buttons: [ { type: 'web_url', url: $json.button_url, title: $json.button_title } ] } } } } : { recipient: { comment_id: $json.comment_id }, message: { text: $json.selected_dm } } }}

nodes.name: Send Private Reply
nodes.notes: POST /{page-id}/messages with recipient.comment_id = Messenger private reply. Button template when button_url is set, plain text otherwise. One private reply per comment, within 7 days. Output 0 = success, output 1 = error.

parameters.query:
UPDATE fb_processed_comments
SET matched_rule = $2, selected_dm = $3, dm_status = 'sent'
WHERE comment_id = $1
RETURNING comment_id, username, matched_rule, selected_dm, dm_status;

nodes.name: Update Row - DM Sent
nodes.notes: RETURNING passes comment_id downstream to the public reply branch.

nodes.name: Update Row - DM Failed
nodes.notes: Status: DM echoue - reponse publique volontairement non envoyee.

nodes.name: Public Replies Configuration
nodes.notes: EDIT ME: the list of possible public replies lives only here.

parameters.jsCode: const list = $json.publicReplies; return { json: { ...$json, selected_public_reply: list[Math.floor(Math.random() * list.length)] } };

nodes.name: Reply to Comment
nodes.notes: POST /{comment-id}/comments - public reply under the comment. Only runs once the private reply has succeeded. Output 0 = success, output 1 = error.

parameters.jsCode:
const base = $('Select Random Public Reply').item.json;
return { json: { ...base, public_reply_status: 'sent' } };

nodes.name: Save Success
nodes.notes: Status: DM envoye, reponse publique envoyee.

nodes.name: Update Row - Public Reply Failed
nodes.notes: Status: DM envoye, reponse publique echouee. Utiliser le workflow "Retry Failed Public Replies" pour reessayer uniquement cette etape.

nodes.name: Handle Error
nodes.notes: Single terminal node for all error branches - makes failed executions easy to spot in the n8n Executions list.

nodes.name: Keyword Matched?
nodes.notes: Continue only if the comment contains a keyword from Message Rules Configuration. Otherwise: no DM, no public reply.

nodes.name: Ignore - No Keyword
nodes.notes: Status: comment ignored (no keyword from the rules list).

nodes.name: Like Comment
nodes.notes: POST /{comment-id}/likes - the Page likes the comment (needs pages_manage_engagement). A failure here never blocks the DM. Disable this node to stop liking.
